#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);

    string s;
    if (!(cin >> s)) return 0;

    const int n = (int)s.size();
    string ans;
    bool seen_at = false;

    auto startsWith = [&](int pos, const string &token) -> bool {
        return pos + (int)token.size() <= n && s.compare(pos, token.size(), token) == 0;
    };

    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        bool advanced = false;

        if (i > 0 && i + 2 < n - 1) {
            if (startsWith(i, "dot")) {
                ans.push_back('.');
                i += 3;
                advanced = true;
            } else if (!seen_at && startsWith(i, "at")) {
                ans.push_back('@');
                seen_at = true;
                i += 2;
                advanced = true;
            }
        }

        if (!advanced && i > 0 && i + 1 < n - 1 && !seen_at && startsWith(i, "at")) {
            ans.push_back('@');
            seen_at = true;
            i += 2;
            advanced = true;
        }

        if (!advanced) {
            ans.push_back(s[i]);
            ++i;
        }
    }

    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}
